doc: Bulk 10 P2b (19 Nov): schema of the master sheet tab "Teaching points" (sibling of columns.json; Lessons/Courses are not changed). Created once at the END of the tab list by .github/workflows/master-teaching-points.yml (scripts/master/teaching-points.mjs), which also gives every new term a term_id. SYSTEM = written by the job, protected (editor: the service account only); TEAM = the team edits it. The partner sheet tab "Terms (copy)" carries term_id, term_km, term_pali, term_en, other_spellings.
id_format: T + 4 digits (T0001, T0002, ...): given in sheet order to a row with a term and no term_id; never reused (data/master/term-ids.json keeps every id ever given).

columns.source: Stable id, never reused. Given by the job to a row that has term_km, term_pali or term_en and no term_id.
The teaching point in Khmer, exactly as typed.
Free notes; never read by any job.
